name: MeUp WF-02 (Postgres) · Conciliación comprobantes ↔ movimientos bancarios

parameters.query:
select id_doc as "ID_DOC", clasificacion as "CLASIFICACION", estado as "ESTADO",
       ocr_valor as "OCR_VALOR", ocr_fecha_pago as "OCR_FECHA_PAGO", ocr_cliente as "OCR_CLIENTE",
       id_compra_informado as "ID_COMPRA_INFORMADO", url_drive as "URL_DRIVE"
from comprobantes_wa
where clasificacion is distinct from 'COMPROBANTE_EGRESO'
  and estado in ('PROCESADO','SIN_MATCH');

select id_mov as "ID_MOV", fecha as "FECHA", valor as "VALOR", tipo as "TIPO",
       id_conciliacion as "ID_CONCILIACION", tercero as "TERCERO", referencia as "REFERENCIA",
       descripcion as "DESCRIPCION", factura_oc as "FACTURA_OC"
from bancos_mov;

update comprobantes_wa set id_mov_match = $2::text, estado = 'CONCILIADO', updated_at = now()
where id_doc = $1::text;

update comprobantes_wa set estado = $2::text, notas = $3::text, updated_at = now()
where id_doc = $1::text;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Motor de matching').item.json.mov.ID_MOV, $('Motor de matching').item.json.ID_COMPRA_INFORMADO || $('Motor de matching').item.json.mov.FACTURA_OC || '', $('Motor de matching').item.json.OCR_CLIENTE || $('Motor de matching').item.json.mov.TERCERO || '', ($('Motor de matching').item.json.ID_COMPRA_INFORMADO ? 'ID ' + $('Motor de matching').item.json.ID_COMPRA_INFORMADO + ' ' : '') + ($('Motor de matching').item.json.OCR_CLIENTE || ''), $('Motor de matching').item.json.ID_DOC] }}
